reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Financing institution license requirement and exemptions
headings.reviewNote: License required to engage in business as financing institution; exempts banks, trust companies, lenders, sales finance licensees, and occasional buyers.

headings.title: Application requirements, fees, and licensing period
headings.reviewNote: Written sworn application, fee caps, tiered fee for low active accounts, calendar year licensing period, and consumer licensing fund credit.

headings.title: Office location specification and address changes
headings.reviewNote: License must specify office/branch and be displayed; director endorses change of location without charge.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections and history note against archived text; preserved catchline ("Financial institutions") vs body ("financing institution") distinction, tiered fee caps, calendar-year period, and section 361.170 fund credit.

headings.title: Grounds for renewal denial, suspension, or revocation
headings.reviewNote: Four grounds for denying renewal or suspending/revoking license: application misstatements, willful violations, defrauding retail buyers, and credit sales misrepresentations.

headings.title: Responsibility for officer, partner, and employee acts
headings.reviewNote: Officer, director, trustee, or partner acts are cause for suspension/revocation; licensee responsible for ratified employee acts after actual knowledge.

headings.title: Hearing and review under chapter 536
headings.reviewNote: Disciplinary action prohibited except after hearing conducted pursuant to chapter 536.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections and history note against archived text; refined all 3 titles to reflect renewal denial scope, disciplinary imputation for officers/partners/employees, and chapter 536 hearing/review.

headings.title: Director investigation and record examination powers
headings.reviewNote: Director authority to investigate financing institutions and compel production of books, records, accounts, and documents.

headings.title: Buyer written complaints and targeted inspections
headings.reviewNote: Buyer written complaint procedure for credit sales law violations and director inspection of pertinent contracts and records.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; refined subsection (2) title to match "buyer" statutory terminology for section 408.250 to 408.370 complaints.

headings.title: Promulgation and advance mailing of administrative rules
headings.reviewNote: Rulemaking authority; mandatory fifteen days advance mailing to licensees; nonreceipt does not exempt compliance.

headings.title: Subpoena and oath administration powers
headings.reviewNote: Director authority to issue subpoenas for witness attendance and document production, and to administer oaths.

headings.title: Circuit court enforcement of administrative subpoenas
headings.reviewNote: Application to circuit judge upon refusal to obey subpoena; clerk issues judicial subpoena under seal.

headings.title: Contempt proceedings and judicial sanctions
headings.reviewNote: Contempt attachment, arrest by law enforcement, fine up to $100, jail imprisonment, and assessment of costs for subpoena noncompliance.

headings.title: Statutory procedure for administrative rulemaking
headings.reviewNote: Rules effective only if promulgated pursuant to section 536.024.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 5 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed rulemaking advance mailing, subpoena/oath powers, circuit court enforcement, contempt penalties, and section 536.024 rulemaking.

headings.title: Premium finance company license requirement
headings.reviewNote: Mandatory premium finance company license issued by director to engage in insurance premium financing business.

headings.title: Licensing fees, account tiers, and fiscal period
headings.reviewNote: Fee schedule, $1,000/$5,000 caps, low-volume account discount, July 1 to June 30 licensing period, and deposit in consumer licensing fund.

headings.title: Application contents and revised statement fee
headings.reviewNote: Required application contents, officer solvency oath, corporate standing, and $300 fee for filing material change revisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed premium finance license mandate, tiered fees, July 1–June 30 period, sworn application contents, and $300 revision fee.

headings.title: Duty to maintain premium finance records
headings.reviewNote: Premium finance company must maintain records of all premium finance transactions.

headings.title: Two-year preservation period and acceptable media
headings.reviewNote: Records must be preserved for at least two years after final entry; authorizes microfilm, microfiche, or photographic media.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed transaction recordkeeping duty, two-year preservation period, and photographic/microfilm/microfiche compliance.

headings.title: Limitation to authorized interest or discount charges
headings.reviewNote: Premium finance companies prohibited from contracting for or collecting unauthorized interest or discount charges.

headings.title: Computation of interest on premium balance
headings.reviewNote: Interest computed on net unpaid premium balance from effective insurance date to final installment maturity.

headings.title: Maximum rates, service charge, and nonconsumer exception
headings.reviewNote: Maximum $15 per $100 per year (15% add-on) plus $10 nonrefundable service charge; parties may agree to any stated rate for non-personal/family/household premiums.

headings.title: Prepayment rights and actuarial refund calculation
headings.reviewNote: Insured right to prepay balance in full at any time with refund calculated under actuarial method.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections and Effective 7-01-03 note against archived text; refined subsections (1) and (3) titles to match interest/discount scope and non-personal/family/household rate exception.

headings.title: Delinquency and contract cancellation charges
headings.reviewNote: Delinquency charge up to 5% after five days default (capped at $15 for consumer loans); $15 insurance cancellation charge.

headings.title: Permitted collection costs and attorney fees
headings.reviewNote: Permits agreement to provide collection costs and attorney fees equal to 20% of outstanding indebtedness when referred to non-salaried collection agency or attorney.

headings.title: Usury law exemption for authorized charges
headings.reviewNote: Authorized delinquency, cancellation, and collection charges excluded from usury determinations.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections and history note against archived text; refined subsection (2) title to preserve permissive authorization for 20% collection costs and attorney fees.

headings.title: Power of attorney cancellation restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Power of attorney cancellation clauses subject to mandatory statutory procedures.

headings.title: Ten-day written notice of intent to cancel
headings.reviewNote: Minimum ten days advance written notice mailed to insured to cure default before cancellation.

headings.title: Cancellation notice to insurer and insured
headings.reviewNote: Company mails cancellation notice to insurer and copy to insured; operates as insured cancellation without policy return.

headings.title: Third-party notice requirements and effective date
headings.reviewNote: Insurer must notify governmental agencies, mortgagees, or third parties within two business days and determine effective cancellation date.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections and history note against archived text; refined subsection (4) title to cover statutory, regulatory, and contractual third-party notice restrictions and two-business-day insurer deadline.
